description.value: Solly's Bagelry is a Vancouver institution billing itself as 'Jewish Baking and Deli at its Finest,' offering freshly baked traditional bagels, deli items, soups, sandwiches, and grocery staples. The Up Main location on Main Street is one of three Vancouver retail outlets for the brand. It's a practical urban food stop for touring cyclists riding the Main Street corridor looking for a hearty, freshly made meal.

concerns: OSM name 'Solly's' differs from the full business name 'Solly's Bagelry' as used consistently on the website; consider updating the OSM record.
This is a multi-location business (Up Main, Kitsilano, Yukon & 7th); the OSM node and this listing represent only the Up Main / 4071 Main St location.
